I was lucky to get a coupon from FISP this year, so I will apply one bag of NPK fertilizer on my maize plot because the soil is tired from planting maize every season. I also collected goat manure during the dry season and I will mix it in at planting to help the maize grow strong, and I am using the hybrid seed I got from the agro-dealer since it yields better than local seed. I cannot afford pesticides or irrigation, and since the plot is small, my children and I can do all the weeding and harvesting ourselves without hiring anyone.
